name: Reaper::child_token / Reaper::cancel / TaskTeardown

test_list.description: Cancelling the reaper's root token cancels children, grandchildren and great-grandchildren (three levels below the root).
Cancelling one child token cancels its own subtree only: the sibling subtree and the root stay live.
A child token requested after the root was cancelled is cancelled from the start.
By the time the first resource is torn down the root token (and its children) are already cancelled.
A registered task parked on its child token exits cooperatively during shutdown and is reported Released, not Forced.
Drop is synchronous best effort: a reaper dropped without shutdown still cancels every child token.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The reaper's root token; every child_token() is a child of it.

output_description: A child token that is cancelled when the root or any ancestor is cancelled, never when a sibling is.
